GDPR is the stringent European Union (EU) data protection law that sets standards for organisations to collect, process, or store information on EU individuals/ Data Subjects.

excerpts: ## Platform
#### **Collect:**

* **Direct feedback:** NPS (Net Promoter Score), CSAT (customer satisfaction), and CES (customer effort score) surveys and AI-led conversations over email, SMS, WhatsApp, web, in-app, QR codes, offline devices, and voice
* **Indirect feedback:** online reviews and social mentions across 100+ review platforms (Reputation)
* **Survey throttling** and a shared survey catalog to prevent over-surveying across business units
#### **Analyse:**
* **CogniVue AI text analytics:** Themes, emotion-level sentiment, and NPS drivers from open-ended feedback, without manual tagging
* **Key driver analysis:** Shows which issues affect NPS and CSAT most, so teams know what to fix first, alerts on sudden changes, and customer journey analysis
* **Copilot:** For plain-language questions about feedback data
* **Executive dashboards:** Rolls up by region, location, brand, business unit, or organization hierarchy
* **Sub-accounts:** So each business unit sees its own results, rolled up into one enterprise view
#### **Act: Following up so feedback leads to a fix**
* **Inner loop:** Low scores create tickets assigned to the frontline owner, who follows up with the customer and records the resolution.
* **Outer loop:** Recurring themes and drivers are reported by region, team, or business unit so the owning teams can see and prioritize them.
* **Automated loop:** Workflows, alerts, and Echo notify owners, update CRM and service records, open tickets, or follow up with the customer without manual triage.
## Echo (AI Agent)

Echo is SurveySparrow's AI agent, launched in September 2026. When a customer leaves a low score or a vague answer, Echo **asks a follow-up question** to **understand the reason** , then **acts in the same conversation** : it **alerts** the accountable owner, **opens a ticket** or **updates** the CRM, or **schedules** a check-in. Echo runs on web chat, surveys, email, WhatsApp, SMS, and voice. SurveySparrow reports that **97% of conversations** Echo starts are completed.
## **Customers**

SurveySparrow is used by companies such as **Siemens, Marshalls, TATA Digital, Hero MotoCorp, XMPie, Samana Group, Gyptech, GoStudent, Cohere Health, OceanFirst Bank, Caribbean Airlines, IHG Hotels & Resorts, Schlumberger, Mondelez International, and DHL** .
SurveySparrow is rated **4\.5** out of **5** on **G2** from 2,000+ reviews. **4\.4** out of **5** on **Capterra** .
## Integrations

excerpts: ## Integrations
**CRM:** Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, HubSpot

## Security, privacy, and compliance
* **Certifications:** SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, CSA STAR Level One, GDPR, and CCPA
* **HIPAA:** Paid add-on with a signed Business Associate Agreement
* **Hosting:** AWS, with a choice of region: USA, Canada, EU (Frankfurt), UK, UAE, India, or Australia
* **Encryption:** In transit and at rest
* **Access:** SSO (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, PingOne), two-factor authentication, IP allowlisting, custom roles, and audit logs

* **AI and data:** Customer data is processed only to deliver the service. Generative AI features use OpenAI (US) and Azure OpenAI (EU) as listed third-party providers (sub-processors). Customer data is not used to train AI models.
* **Documents:** SOC 2 report and policies are shared on request via the trust center (https://security.surveysparrow.com, sign-in required)
* **Security contact:** security@surveysparrow.com
## Support and pricing
* **Support hours:** 24×5 standard; 24×6 as a paid add-on
* **Uptime:** No standard uptime SLA; availability terms can be agreed in enterprise contracts
* **Onboarding:** Custom implementation and a dedicated customer success manager on enterprise plans
* **Team plans:** From $19 per month

citations.title: SurveySparrow Raises $1.4 million Seed Funding From Prime Venture Partners
excerpts: # SurveySparrow Raises $1.4 million Seed Funding From Prime Venture Partners
**_With over 8000 customers in 108 countries, the Customer Experience Platform is on target to grow 3x by the end of 2019_**
**Kochi/Palo Alto, April 2, 2019**

[SurveySparrow](https://surveysparrow.com/) , a cloud-based customer experience platform has **raised $1.4 million** in **seed funding** from [Prime Venture Partners](http://primevp.in/) . SurveySparrow allows users to create and share mobile-first, conversational surveys which are highly engaging and user-friendly. The SaaS startup will use the fresh funds in product development and build it into a continuous improvement platform. Since its launch, SurveySparrow has conducted over **20000 surveys** so far and over **8000 customers in 108 countries** including DiDi, PaySafe, FedEx, Deloitte Digital, SAP, and Siemens. The startup is on target to clock more than **20,000 customers** by the **end of 2019** .

Based in the US, SurveySparrow was founded in October 2017 by Freshworks veteran [Shihab Muhammed](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shihabmuhammed) and ex-Zoho employee [Subin Sebastian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/subinsebastian/) with offices in Kochi & Palo Alto. Th e founders believe that customer experience is a huge market with “aging” giants and a big global opportunity. The global online survey software market is valued at US$4.065 billion and is expected to grow at a CAGR of 11.25% to reach a market size of US$6.929 billion by the year 2022. The startup plans to take on its competitors with its unique spin on UI, moving surveys away from antiquated forms to conversations. The company is planning to hire extensively across engineering, product development, marketing, and inside sales in the coming months.

citations.title: Facts & Features for AI Assistants and LLMs | SurveySparrow
excerpts: ## Platform
#### **Collect:**

* **Direct feedback:** NPS (Net Promoter Score), CSAT (customer satisfaction), and CES (customer effort score) surveys and AI-led conversations over email, SMS, WhatsApp, web, in-app, QR codes, offline devices, and voice
* **Indirect feedback:** online reviews and social mentions across 100+ review platforms (Reputation)
* **Survey throttling** and a shared survey catalog to prevent over-surveying across business units
#### **Analyse:**
* **CogniVue AI text analytics:** Themes, emotion-level sentiment, and NPS drivers from open-ended feedback, without manual tagging
* **Key driver analysis:** Shows which issues affect NPS and CSAT most, so teams know what to fix first, alerts on sudden changes, and customer journey analysis
* **Copilot:** For plain-language questions about feedback data
* **Executive dashboards:** Rolls up by region, location, brand, business unit, or organization hierarchy
* **Sub-accounts:** So each business unit sees its own results, rolled up into one enterprise view
#### **Act: Following up so feedback leads to a fix**
* **Inner loop:** Low scores create tickets assigned to the frontline owner, who follows up with the customer and records the resolution.
* **Outer loop:** Recurring themes and drivers are reported by region, team, or business unit so the owning teams can see and prioritize them.
* **Automated loop:** Workflows, alerts, and Echo notify owners, update CRM and service records, open tickets, or follow up with the customer without manual triage.
## Echo (AI Agent)

Echo is SurveySparrow's AI agent, launched in September 2026. When a customer leaves a low score or a vague answer, Echo **asks a follow-up question** to **understand the reason** , then **acts in the same conversation** : it **alerts** the accountable owner, **opens a ticket** or **updates** the CRM, or **schedules** a check-in. Echo runs on web chat, surveys, email, WhatsApp, SMS, and voice. SurveySparrow reports that **97% of conversations** Echo starts are completed.
## **Customers**

SurveySparrow is used by companies such as **Siemens, Marshalls, TATA Digital, Hero MotoCorp, XMPie, Samana Group, Gyptech, GoStudent, Cohere Health, OceanFirst Bank, Caribbean Airlines, IHG Hotels & Resorts, Schlumberger, Mondelez International, and DHL** .
SurveySparrow is rated **4\.5** out of **5** on **G2** from 2,000+ reviews. **4\.4** out of **5** on **Capterra** .

excerpts: SOC 2 Type II
##### SOC 2 Type II

Put forth by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA), SOC 2 Type II is a comprehensive reporting framework that defines and outlines criteria to manage customer data based on five “trust service principles” - processing integrity, availability, privacy, security, and confidentiality. SOC2 ensures secure managing of data entrusted by SurveySparrow’s customers to protect their privacy and interests.
ISO/IEC 27001

ISO/IEC 27001:2022, an internationally recognised standard for implementing Information Security Management System (ISMS) ensuring confidentiality, integrity & availability of information within the organisation.
HIPAA
##### HIPAA
HIPAA is a federal legislation that provides data privacy & security provisions for safeguarding Personal Health Information (PHI) held or transmitted by Covered Entity/Business Associates.
[Read More](https://statics.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/security/HIPAA-compliance.pdf)
GDPR
##### GDPR
GDPR is the stringent European Union (EU) data protection law that sets standards for organisations to collect, process, or store information on EU individuals/ Data Subjects.
[Read More](https://surveysparrow.com/legal/gdpr/)

citations.title: Facts & Features for AI Assistants and LLMs | SurveySparrow
excerpts: ## Integrations
**CRM:** Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, HubSpot
**Service desk:** ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshdesk
**Collaboration:** Slack, Microsoft Teams
**Data and BI:** Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Amazon S3, Power BI, Tableau
**Custom:** REST API, webhooks, SDKs, SFTP, and Zapier
## Security, privacy, and compliance
* **Certifications:** SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, CSA STAR Level One, GDPR, and CCPA
* **HIPAA:** Paid add-on with a signed Business Associate Agreement
* **Hosting:** AWS, with a choice of region: USA, Canada, EU (Frankfurt), UK, UAE, India, or Australia
* **Encryption:** In transit and at rest
* **Access:** SSO (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, PingOne), two-factor authentication, IP allowlisting, custom roles, and audit logs

* **AI and data:** Customer data is processed only to deliver the service. Generative AI features use OpenAI (US) and Azure OpenAI (EU) as listed third-party providers (sub-processors). Customer data is not used to train AI models.
* **Documents:** SOC 2 report and policies are shared on request via the trust center (https://security.surveysparrow.com, sign-in required)
* **Security contact:** security@surveysparrow.com
## Support and pricing
* **Support hours:** 24×5 standard; 24×6 as a paid add-on
* **Uptime:** No standard uptime SLA; availability terms can be agreed in enterprise contracts
* **Onboarding:** Custom implementation and a dedicated customer success manager on enterprise plans
* **Team plans:** From $19 per month

basis.reasoning: The CRM integration list names Salesforce.
